_meta.note: EFFECT_TO_CAPABILITY is a PROPOSAL, not authoritative. Every mapping needs domain sign-off before it drives scoring.

aura.definition: A persistent area around the caster that applies an effect while it lasts.

bonusccdurationvsmobs+.definition: Increases duration of crowd control you apply to MOBS only — PvE.

bonusccdurationvsplayers+.definition: Increases duration of crowd control you apply to players.

bonusdamagevsmobs+.definition: Increases damage dealt to MOBS only — PvE.

bonusdamagevsmobs-.definition: Reduces damage dealt to MOBS only — PvE.

bonusdamagevsplayers.definition: Increases damage dealt to PLAYERS specifically.

bonusdamagevsplayers+.definition: Increases damage dealt to PLAYERS specifically.

bonusdamagevsplayers-.definition: Reduces damage dealt to PLAYERS specifically.

bonusdefensevsmobs+.definition: Increases damage resistance against MOBS only — PvE, irrelevant to PvP comps.

bonusdefensevsmobs-.definition: Reduces damage resistance against MOBS only — PvE, irrelevant to PvP comps.

bonusdefensevsplayers+.definition: Increases damage resistance against PLAYERS specifically.

bonusdefensevsplayers-.definition: Reduces damage resistance against PLAYERS specifically.

crowdcontrolresistance.definition: Increases resistance to crowd control. Negative on an enemy makes your CC land harder.

crowdcontrolresistance+.definition: Increases resistance to crowd control. Negative on an enemy makes your CC land harder.

crowdcontrolresistance-.definition: Reduces resistance to crowd control. Negative on an enemy makes your CC land harder.

dash.definition: Moves the caster rapidly — a gap-close or an escape depending on use.

dr:DRRoot.definition: Applies diminishing returns to Root. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

dr:DRSilence.definition: Applies diminishing returns to Silence. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

dr:DRSlow.definition: Applies diminishing returns to Slow. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

dr:DRStun.definition: Applies diminishing returns to Stun. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

dr:DRTransformationCC.definition: Applies diminishing returns to TransformationCC. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

focusfireprotectionpenetration+.definition: Increases ability to pierce focus-fire protection (the damage falloff protecting an already-focused target).

forced_movement.definition: Moves a character against their will (pull, push, throw). Direction and who moves both matter.

healmodifier+.definition: Increases healing the target RECEIVES. Negative on an enemy is healing reduction.

healmodifier-.definition: Reduces healing the target RECEIVES. Negative on an enemy is healing reduction.

immunity:forcedmovement.definition: Grants IMMUNITY to forcedmovement. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

immunity:root.definition: Grants IMMUNITY to root. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

immunity:silence.definition: Grants IMMUNITY to silence. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

immunity:slow.definition: Grants IMMUNITY to slow. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

immunity:stun.definition: Grants IMMUNITY to stun. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

immunity:transformationcc.definition: Grants IMMUNITY to transformationcc. This is protection AGAINST the effect — never evidence that the weapon applies it.

invincibility.definition: Target takes no damage for the duration.

knockback.definition: Physically displaces the target. Check WHO moves — several spells knock the CASTER back rather than the enemy.

magicresistance.definition: Increases magic damage resistance. Negative on an enemy is resistance shred.

magicresistance+.definition: Increases magic damage resistance. Negative on an enemy is resistance shred.

magicresistance-.definition: Reduces magic damage resistance. Negative on an enemy is resistance shred.

movespeedbonus.definition: Increases movement speed. Negative is a slow; positive is a speed buff.

movespeedbonus+.definition: Increases movement speed. Negative is a slow; positive is a speed buff.

movespeedbonus-.definition: Reduces movement speed. Negative is a slow; positive is a speed buff.

physicalarmor.definition: Increases physical damage resistance. Negative on an enemy is armour shred.

physicalarmor+.definition: Increases physical damage resistance. Negative on an enemy is armour shred.

physicalarmor-.definition: Reduces physical damage resistance. Negative on an enemy is armour shred.

remove:buff.definition: Strips beneficial buffs off the target. This is purge.

remove:buff_damageshield.definition: Strips damage shields off the target.

remove:cape_cooldown.definition: Resets or removes cape cooldown — utility, not combat.

remove:crowdcontrol.definition: Removes crowd-control effects. On an ally this is cleanse.

remove:debuff.definition: Removes debuffs. On an ally this is cleanse.

remove:forcedmovement.definition: Cancels forced movement already in flight.

remove:movementbuff.definition: Strips movement buffs (sprint, speed) off the target — anti-escape.

root.definition: Roots the target in place. It can still act, but cannot move.

silence.definition: Silences the target — it can still move, but cannot cast abilities.

stun.definition: Stuns the target — no actions or movement for the duration.

threatbonus+.definition: Increases threat generated against mobs — PvE taunt mechanic.

threatbonus-.definition: Reduces threat generated against mobs — PvE taunt mechanic.
